description: Metadata registry for Docker containers, images and Kubernetes pods/deployments. SQLite-backed CRUD bookkeeping only — does NOT execute Docker daemon or Kubernetes API calls. See scope_narrowing_note.

scope_allowed: SQLite-backed CRUD for planned/declared Docker containers, images, K8s pods, deployments
REST API mirroring CRUD operations under /api/v1/container/*
Light event emission for registry changes
Bookkeeping role in project_mode worker registration
scope_narrowing_note.expand_path: If real container orchestration is needed later, open separate D3 decision CONTAINER-EXPAND-001 with proper budget, RBAC, audit_sink, and orchestration adapters.
